core_obligations: Construct a uniform smaller support ideal controlling the completion and colimit obstructions, using the retained local annihilation lemmas.
Run the induction on thecohomological cutoff while checking that the depth/dimension alternatives survive passage fromM toM/fM, obtaining the comparison through degrees<=s.

difficulty_reason: The theorem requires one support ideal that works for all subsequent admissible ideals, and an induction whose hypotheses include several interacting depth/dimension alternatives. That uniform construction is H2 beyond an ordinary completion/base-change formula.

editorial_notes: All five hypothesis groups, including the three-way alternative in condition5, remain verbatim. The source future-reference footnote is not used as a proof dependency.

Public310 is an annihilator/depth equivalence. This task constructs a support ideal making a derived-completion comparison an isomorphism in a specified range; it is not that annihilator theorem again.
